requiredBehaviors.behavior: separate role-defining organisational facts from HR and communication metadata
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The prerequisites and communication-context sections explicitly classify role-defining facts separately from HR/communication metadata.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: treat historical candidate requirements as evidence requiring confirmation rather than inherited must-haves
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Historical template content may only be retained when confirmed against current role requirements.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve template language and structure only as downstream communication context
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Template, document structure, branding and language variants are handed downstream as separate communication evidence.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep genuinely unknown headcount or budget values open rather than inventing them
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Checks require genuine unknowns to remain explicit and forbid invented values.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: turn package bonus or corporate wording into candidate capabilities
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Package, bonus, job family and corporate wording are explicitly communication metadata.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: reintroduce known facts as generic placeholders
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Known facts must not be passed onward as open placeholders.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: copy old requirements directly into the approved handoff without validation
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Existing postings are evidence rather than normative sources and conflicts must remain visible.
